jobs.prompt: Create ONE isolated full-body transparent-background raster sprite of the fictional nonhuman Grey Child creature from the ORIGINAL Silent Hill (1999), Japanese/North American PS1 version, using the two supplied original model renders as the sole design authority. Preserve the native small hunched proportions, mottled dark green-grey creature surface, elongated smooth tapered head with shallow indistinct facial slits, hunched high shoulders, two long bent arms, and two short bent legs. Exactly one narrow knife is held in its RIGHT hand, entire handle, blade and tip visible; maintain the narrow native blade rather than a cleaver. Quiet hunched ready stance, both complete feet visible and resting on one invisible ground line, weight plausibly supported, free hand visible forward. Faithfully reconstruct the same game creature from this new viewing direction; do not redesign it as the PAL Mumbler or film creature. One subject only, entire anatomy and knife inside the frame with generous clean margins; no contact shadow, background, floor, second view, text, HUD or labels. Preserve source surface detail without adding blood, victims, injury, or sexual detail. True transparent alpha outside the subject; alpha must remain transparent rather than a checkerboard. Native crisp detailed game-model-style rendering, diffuse neutral illumination suitable for compositing. Prefer a square canvas, complete subject occupying about 70–78% of image height.

Retain the transparent drape, internal empty space and the real suspension mechanism, including the paired upper braces and curved crosspiece visible in the reference. Keep the complete cage bottom and visible attached suspension hardware within generous clear margins; represent only a short visible upper connection segment as in the source, do not invent a ceiling, frame, platform, wheels or long chains. The outer assembly must be fully readable, with no metal rod or body part cut by the image border. True transparent alpha outside the assembly and through open areas; the transparent shroud remains slightly visible, with restrained highlights, not an opaque grey bell. One stationary subject, no target, no attack effects, no smoke, no floor or shadow, no background, no text, no HUD, no extra views. Preserve original muted material colors and aged fabric/metal surface without adding injury or blood. Native detailed game-model-style raster, diffuse neutral illumination, square canvas preferred, assembly about 75–80% of image height.
